values.note: Allegan County Parks: $17 per site per night year-round; seniors 62 and older with ID $8.50. Reservation and service fees are added when booking (the same online or at the office). Horse trail riding $5 per horse per day, paid separately; non-motor watercraft launch free. Walk-ins and off-season campers pay at the yellow-envelope fee tube near the entrance.

fees.source: https://www.allegancounty.org/departments/parks-recreation-and-tourism/campsite-reservations ('Year-round campsite fees at Silver Creek Campground and Ely Lake Campground are $17 per site per night (+ reservation & service fees apply when making a reservation...)'; Ely Lake Campground fee chart: 'Campsite Use Cost: $17.00 per night', 'Senior Campsite Rates (62/Older with ID): $8.50 per night', 'Horse Trail Day Riding: $5 per Horse', 'Watercraft Launch Fee: $0 Non-Motor Only'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked by Allegan County Parks on ReserveAmerica ('Ely Lake County Campground'), up to a year ahead and at least 5 business days before the camp date, for dates April 1 through November. Unreserved sites go to walk-ins first-come (yellow envelope, occupy within 24 hours); 'RESERVED' signs go up early in the week and a walk-in on a site reserved for the weekend may be asked to move. December 1 - March 31 every site is first-come. Refunds only for cancellations 10+ business days out.

booking.source: https://www.allegancounty.org/departments/parks-recreation-and-tourism/campsite-reservations ('Campsites can be reserved through our reservation program for camp dates starting April 1st through November'; 'must be made at least 5 BUSINESS days ... prior to the camp date'; 'Unreserved campsites are available to *walk-ins on a first come/first served basis'; 'The reservation system is open year-round with the ability to make reservations one year in advance.'; 'A minimum 2-night stay is required on a holiday weekend.'; 'Reserve Ely Lake Campsites Online' -> reserveamerica.com/explore/ely-lake-county-campground/PRCG/1066108), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Open year-round; December 1 - March 31 first-come only, unstaffed, roads and restrooms not maintained. Vault toilets open all year; water pumps run spring to fall.

season.source: https://www.allegancounty.org/departments/parks-recreation-and-tourism/campsite-reservations ('SILVER CREEK AND ELY LAKE CAMPGROUNDS ARE OPEN YEAR-ROUND'; 'Off-season December 1st through March 31st ... the campgrounds are not staffed nor are the restrooms/roads maintained during the off-season. Vault toilets are open year-round. Water pumps are available Spring to Fall'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Vault toilets; hand water pumps spring to fall; swimming beach on Ely Lake; DNR public access sites to Ely and Little Tom lakes (Ely is no-motor). Equestrian staging area and trails.

facilities.source: https://www.allegancounty.org/Home/Components/FacilityDirectory/FacilityDirectory/7/462 ('73 primitive campsites (16 of which are open to equestrian camping), vault toilets, and a swimming beach on Ely Lake. You will also find DNR Public Access sites to both Ely and Little Tom Lakes') + campsite-reservations page ('Water pumps are available Spring to Fall'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 73 primitive sites; 58-73 have picket posts for horses, but every site is open to equestrian and non-equestrian campers.

sites.source: https://www.allegancounty.org/departments/parks-recreation-and-tourism/campsite-reservations ('Number of campsites : 73'; 'Ely Lake : campsites 58 - 73 have picket posts however all campsites are available for equestrian and non-equestrian use') + facility page, read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground on no-motor Ely Lake inside the DNR's Allegan State Game Area, 5020 116th Ave, run by Allegan County Parks: close to town with a backcountry feel, a general drive-in campground with horse trails and an equestrian staging area, not equestrian-only. Narrow internal roads make it tight for long rigs but a 23-ft RV fits. --Claude
summary: Allegan County Parks runs and books it (county campsite page + ReserveAmerica 'Ely Lake County Campground'; no DNR page for the campground exists, the DNR owns the game-area land). Confirmed $17/night (senior $8.50 added to the fees note), 73 primitive sites, vault toilets, pump water, ReserveAmerica booking with after-cutoff walk-ins. New: RA url (replaces the inherited MiDNRReservations link), 1-year window, 2-night holiday minimum, year-round season. Phone 269-686-9088 matches the county parks office. Electric 0 left (primitive; not stated outright). Note trimmed of field restatements.
